name: Curse of the Tomb
text: Predict. Give a unit "I take double damage and if I would die, Obliterate me instead" this round.

name: Void Gate
text: Keywords: Landmark. When you summon an ally or an ally dies, grant each of its positive keywords to 3 allies in your deck.

name: Forsaken Baccai
text: Play: Predict. If you pick a Darkin or an equipment, grant me +1|+1.

name: Castigate
text: Kill ALL followers.

name: Heedless Resurrection
text: Once you've equipped an ally this game, I cost 2 less. Revive the Strongest dead allied champion.

name: Camouflaged Horror
text: Keywords: Fearsome, Evolve. Play: I strike an enemy.

name: Rockbear Shepherd
text: When you summon another ally, advance your highest Countdown landmark 1 round. When I'm summoned, summon a Hibernating Rockbear.

name: Priestess Of Desert Light
text: Round Start: Deal 4 to me. Draw a champion and grant it +2|+2. If your deck started with 6+ different champions, summon it instead.

name: The Darkin Bloodletters
text: Keywords: Equipment. Last Breath: If my bearer is not a Darkinthrall, summon a Darkinthrall. You may spend 6 mana and kill an ally to play me as Xolaani.

name: Swinging Glaive
text: Keywords: Equipment. Strike: Create a Lucky Find in hand.

name: Catch!
text: Give an ally +1|+1 this round or equip it with an equipment in hand that costs 2 or less.

name: Kind-hearted Recruit
text: When I'm summoned, give Equipped allies Barrier this round.

name: Silence and Suppress
text: Destroy a unit's equipment, and if it's a follower, Silence it.

name: Roar of Icathia
text: Summon 2 Icathian Mirages Equipped with up to 2 Equipment in hand that cost 2 or less.

name: The Darkin Aegis
text: Keywords: Equipment, Tough. You may spend 5 mana to play me as Joraal.

name: Vayne
text: When I'm summoned or Round Start: Create a Tumble in hand or if you have one, reduce its cost by 1. Level up: I've seen you attack 4 times.

name: Trusty Ramhound
text: The first time you summon an Elite, grant me +2|+2.

name: Condemn
text: If you've attacked 2+ times this round, I cost 5 less. An ally strikes an enemy.

name: Champions' Strength
text: Give allies +4|+4 this round and Rally.

name: Icathian Myths
text: Create an Icathian Mirage in hand that costs 0 this round, or create a Golden Spatula in hand.

name: Petricite Charger
text: Keywords: Formidable. I don't take damage from enemy spells or Skills.

name: Fish Fight
text: An ally and an enemy strike each other, or an Equipped ally strikes an enemy, then is unequipped.

name: Tempting Prospect
text: Pick a follower or equipment from the top 4 cards of your deck. Draw it, place the rest into your deck.

name: Bloodcursed Harpy
text: Keywords: Scout. Play: Equip me with an equipment that costs 2 or less from hand. The first time I would die while Equipped, fully heal me and destroy the equipment instead.

name: Zealous Ranger-Knight
text: Attack: Give Equipped allies +1|+1 this round.

name: Widowed Huntress
text: Keywords: Challenger. Play: Equip me with an equipment that costs 2 or less from hand.

name: Steadfast Elkin
text: The first time an ally is Equipped, grant me Tough.

name: Ranger-Knight Defector
text: Keywords: Tough. Once you've Equipped an ally this game, grant me Scout.

name: Combat Cook
text: When I'm summoned, I Improvise, then Forge me.

name: Faithful Wolfdog
text: If an ally died this round, I cost 2 less. Play: Equip me with an equipment that costs 2 or less from hand and Forge me.

name: Soul Cleave
text: Kill an ally to summon 2 Ephemeral copies of it.

name: The Darkin Halberd
text: Keywords: Equipment. To play me, kill an ally. You may spend 10 mana to play me as Taarosh.

name: Wraith of Echoes
text: Round End: For each ally that died this round, grant all allied copies of it everywhere +1|+1.

name: Malefic Spear
text: Keywords: Equipment, Fearsome. If an ally died this round, I cost 2 less.

name: Quietus
text: Kill a unit with total Power and Health of 4 or less, or destroy a unit's equipment.

name: Blades of the Fallen
text: Give an ally "Last Breath: Summon a Icathian Mirage with my equipment" this round.

name: Opulent Foyer
text: Keywords: Landmark. When I am summoned, summon a Ghastly Band. Round Start: If you have the attack token, summon a Ghastly Band.

name: Redeemed Prodigy
text: Attack: Summon an attacking Ghastly Band.

name: Fireth, Reaper of the Sands
text: Keywords: Ephemeral, Can't Block. When I'm summoned, I Improvise.

name: Keeper of the Box
text: Keywords: Fearsome. Once you've Equipped an ally this game, grant me Lifesteal.

name: Shape of Fear
text: Kill an ally to summon an Encroaching Mist.

name: Deathless Knight
text: Keywords: Fearsome. When I would gain Ephemeral, grant me +1|+1 instead.

name: Utter Devastation
text: Kill ALL units except Darkin allies and Equipped allies.

name: Ceaseless Sentry
text: Keywords: Last Breath. Last Breath: Draw 1.

name: Moonlit Glenkeeper
text: Keywords: Fearsome. When you summon an Ephemeral ally, grant it +1|+0. Nightfall: Summon a Sapling.

name: Augmented Clockling
text: Keywords: Elusive. Play: Predict, then draw 1 and reduce its cost by 1.

name: Flashbomb Peddler
text: Keywords: Imbue. When you play a spell, plant 1 Flashbomb Trap in the top 8 cards of the enemy deck.

name: Blowback
text: Deal 1 to an enemy and the enemy Nexus. Discard up to 2 to increase the damage by 1 for each card discarded.

name: Stylish Shot
text: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus. The next time an ally strikes the Nexus this round, create a Stylish Shot in hand.

name: Elegant Edge
text: Keywords: Fearsome, Plunder. Plunder: Grant me +2|+0.

name: Pirouette
text: Keywords: Plunder. Plunder: I cost 2 less. Deal 1 to anything and Stun an enemy.

name: Samira
text: Keywords: Quick Attack, Plunder. Plunder or strike: Create a Flair in hand if you don't already have one. Level up: I've seen you play 6 cards. Resets when you start a round with the attack token.

name: Dashing Dandy
text: Keywords: Plunder, Overwhelm. Plunder: Double my power.

name: Dame the Despoiler
text: Keywords: Plunder, Overwhelm. Plunder: Grant allies +1|+0.

name: All Out
text: Keywords: Plunder. Give an ally +2|+0 this round. Plunder: Give it +2|+1 instead.

name: Adroit Artificer
text: Keywords: Challenger. When I'm summoned, activate all ally Plunder effects.

name: Daring Demolisher
text: Play: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus or activate an ally's Plunder effect.

name: Captain Indari
text: Keywords: Plunder. When I'm summoned, I Improvise. Plunder: Forge other allies.

name: Mad Ol' Babs
text: Keywords: Attune. When you refill mana, grant me +1|+0 for each mana refilled.

name: Brazen Buccaneer
text: Keywords: Plunder, Brash. Plunder: Summon a random 1 cost follower and grant it Brash.

name: Jack
text: Keywords: Brash. Strike: Create a Coin in hand. When you refill mana, heal me 1 for each mana refilled. Level up: You've spent 12+ mana in one round.

name: Nukkle
text: Keywords: Elusive. When I'm summoned, create a Fleeting Mako in hand.

name: Perfidious Promoter
text: When you refill mana, create a Fleeting random follower in hand you can exactly afford.

name: Pocket Picker
text: Keywords: Last Breath. Last Breath: Create a Coin in hand.

name: Five-Punch Pablo
text: Keywords: Attune. When I'm summoned, create a Fleeting Prize Fight in hand.

name: Angel
text: Keywords: Brash, Plunder. Plunder: Create 3 Coins in hand.

name: Risky Venture
text: Deal 3 to a unit. If this kills it, create 2 Coins in hand.

name: Barbed Chain
text: Keywords: Plunder. Plunder: I cost 2 less. Draw 2 at the next Round Start and grant them Fleeting.

name: Father Fury
text: Keywords: Plunder, Elusive. Plunder: Refill 1 spell mana and create a random 1 cost spell from your regions in hand.

name: Prize Fight
text: An ally and an enemy strike each other. They can't drop below 1 Health from this strike.

name: Barknuckles
text: Keywords: Equipment, Brash. Strike: Create a Coin in hand.

name: The King's Court
text: Keywords: Attune, Brash. When I'm summoned, draw a Jack. When you summon an ally, create a Fleeting Prize Fight in hand. When an ally survives damage, grant it Brash.

name: Inferna
text: Keywords: Elusive. When you activate Plunder, draw 1 and grant it Fleeting.

name: Tag Out!
text: Recall an ally and create a Coin in hand, or spend 5 mana to Recall an enemy and create a Coin in hand.

name: Master Bingwen, the Sieve
text: Keywords: Elusive. Play: The next time you play a unit this round, summon an exact Ephemeral copy of it.

name: The Old Timer
text: Keywords: Double Attack. Play: Recall the strongest enemy. If you've spent 16+ mana this round, Recall all enemies instead.

name: Sett
text: Keywords: Challenger. The first time I would drop below 1 Health while attacking, give me Barrier instead. Level up: You've spent 40+ mana.

name: Royal Shimmerwing
text: Keywords: Quick Attack, Missing Translation. Other Bird allies have +1|+0 and Quick Attack.

name: Attentive Accountant
text: Keywords: Elusive. Nexus Strike: Create a Coin in hand.

name: Smooth Mixologist
text: Play: Heal an ally or your Nexus 3 and create a Coin in hand.

name: Place Your Bets
text: Draw 2 and create 2 Coins in hand.

name: Beguiling Cobra
text: Each round, the first time you play another follower, summon an exact copy of it. If your board is full, grant its stats and keywords to me instead.

name: Pit Professional
text: When I'm summoned, create a Coin in hand.

name: Bout Security
text: When I'm summoned, create a Fleeting Bout Security in hand and grant other Bout Security +1|+1. Empowered 5: Quick Attack.

name: Facebreaker
text: Stun 2 enemies and create a Coin in hand.

name: Fallen Sands General
text: Keywords: Overwhelm. I have +1|+0 for each Ephemeral ally you've summoned this game.

name: Secret Keeper
text: When I'm summoned, create at the bottom of your deck two random level 2 champions that aren't in your hand, deck, or play.

name: Pack Attack
text: Start a free attack with an exact Ephemeral copy of each Cat ally.

name: Frostcoat Cub
text: Spend 6 mana to play me as Frostcoat Mother instead.

name: Innovative Blacksmith
text: When I'm summoned, I Improvise. Each round, the first time you Forge or Equip an ally, heal your Nexus 1.

name: Soul Harvest
text: Kill a follower with 3 or less Power, or spend 3 mana to kill a champion with 3 or less Power.

name: Eradication
text: Kill ALL units with 3 or less Power.

name: Grave Companion
text: Each round, the first time another ally dies, draw 1.

name: Cosmic Youngling
text: Round Start: Heal me and your Nexus 1.

name: Sacrificial Scholar
text: Keywords: Last Breath. Last Breath: Create in hand copies of the first 3 spells you played on me.

name: Pie Toss
text: Deal 1 to a unit. Create a Perilous Pastry in hand.
